# FamFirst Clinic Bandar Rimbayu

FamFirst Clinic is a private medical clinic at No 6-G, Jalan Flora 1/3, Bandar Rimbayu, 42500 Telok Panglima Garang, Selangor, Malaysia.

Primary phone: +603-5525 8837
Website preview: https://shukritobi.github.io/famfirst-clinic-rimbayu/

## Focused patient pathways
- Doctor-guided weight management: /services/weight-management.html
- Skin tag and benign lesion assessment: /services/skin-tag-removal.html
- Skin health and facial consultation: /services/skin-health-facials.html

## Established clinic services
General medical consultation, medical screening, women’s health, vaccination, wound care and ultrasound are listed on the clinic's existing public website.

## Important limitations
All treatments, procedures, medicines and supplements require assessment by a registered medical practitioner. Treatment results vary. Proposed aesthetic services must be confirmed against the clinic's CKAPS registration, practitioner credentials and Medicine Advertisements Board requirements before public launch.
